card.name: Digits inside section numbers and statistics
card.fires_on: A single digit such as 5, 1, 2 or 7 that begins or sits inside a number, often right after an opening parenthesis or bracket. Seen in cross-references like Warnings and Precautions (5.2), and in percentages and counts like (5/111) or (17%).

modes.label: Section cross-references
modes.description: The digit 5 (or similar) opening a section number inside a see-reference in a drug label.

modes.label: Counts and percentages
modes.description: A leading digit of a patient count, fraction or percent in trial results.
modes.example: two of 12 (<<1>>7%) patients with missense mutations had

modes.label: Other numbers
modes.description: Digits in dates, citations or dose tables outside label cross-references.

card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a number, mostly in label section references and trial statistics.
